Nate Herk, I feel so good to be with you through your videos. I just realized it's been 1+ year of watching your videos, from workflows, agentic workflows, autonomous framework-based agents, Claude Code + folder workspace, Claude Code/Codex powerful AI OS as Nate-2, and it goes on to Grok bot, etc.

Really, I have learned 80% about AI Automation from you. Also, after watching other creators' videos, I realized how good yours are. Others are also good in this field, but I chose yours through my interest.

As I was doing free Google Digital Marketing and E-commerce certification, hunting for clients, and trying to find videos on how to automate outreach or sales using AI, I got into your videos, and then... found an interest in AI Automation and started building workflows one-by-one, node-by-node, taking inspiration from or sometimes copying your templates, spending 14+ hours a day playing around with it. I don't even get bored or exhausted, even though.

Hearty congratulations to you and me as a learner who has gained a lot from the AI Automation and content you have made. It always feels great to meet each other with the same learning and sharing intent. Congrats once again.👏

text:
Nate, congratulations on 1 million subscribers! 🎉 This milestone was especially meaningful to me because you reached it on my birthday. It felt like receiving a gift from someone who, without even knowing me, has already made such a big difference in my life.
So much of what I’m building today comes from what I’ve learned from you and your videos. Your lessons help me turn ideas into real projects and give me the confidence to keep learning and creating.
That’s why seeing you reach this milestone on that particular day meant so much to me. You’re part of my journey, and celebrating my birthday alongside this moment in yours made it even more special.
Thank you for sharing so much knowledge. Among those million subscribers is someone deeply grateful for everything you’ve taught me. Here’s to many more milestones! Sending a big hug from Brazil! 🇧🇷👏

Grande parte do que estou construindo hoje aprendi com você e com seus vídeos. Seus ensinamentos me ajudam a transformar ideias em projetos reais e me dão confiança para continuar aprendendo e criando.
Por isso, fiquei tão emocionado em ver essa conquista acontecer nessa data. Você faz parte da minha caminhada, e foi uma alegria poder comemorar meu aniversário junto com esse momento da sua história.
